node.statement: Quadratic absorption: exact unitality and bilinearity give h bold-dot h-J=(J+a) bold-dot (J+a)-J=2a+a bold-dot a. Combining the assumed defect ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<=3*epsilon_r with 1.3.1 yields 2||a||<=6*epsilon_r+(1+epsilon_r)||a||^2. Since ||a||<delta<=1/16 and epsilon_r<=1/16, (1+epsilon_r)||a||^2<=(17/256)||a||. Thus (495/256)||a||<=6*epsilon_r, so ||a||<=(1536/495)*epsilon_r<=4*epsilon_r.
